template_data.headline_html: Five SAM.gov errors that silently freeze your contracts.

items.title: UEI / IRS name mismatch
items.sub: Validation flags you when these don't align — everything stalls.

items.title: Stale NAICS codes
items.sub: Agencies filter by NAICS; wrong codes make you invisible.

items.title: Expired registration
items.sub: No reminder comes. New awards stop, active contracts can pause.

items.title: Outdated ACH / banking
items.sub: Wrong direct deposit info means payment failures on won contracts.

items.title: Unmonitored POC inbox
items.sub: RFQs and CO outreach land here — if no one's watching, you miss them.
